issue.title: Open Launch Control from usage-limit disable notifications
issue.description: PROPOSED BY: phase bead sase-n4.3 of epic sase-n4. The new llm.usage_limit notification in src/sase/notifications/senders.py intentionally ships without an action under the original phase's documented fallback. Add a real, handled notification action that opens Launch Control / the Models panel: define the action and action_data on notify_provider_usage_limit_disabled, route it through src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_notification_modal_flow.py and the notification modal action-support vocabulary, add a focused handler using the existing open_models_panel app action, and cover sender composition plus modal dispatch so selecting the notification never falls into the unsupported-action warning. This is an optional navigation enhancement, not required for sase-n4 correctness.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by 19bdc94db (2026-08-20): 'Usage-limit notifications now carry OpenLaunchControl so selecting one opens Launch Control.' notify_provider_usage_limit_disabled sets action='OpenLaunchControl' with action_data={'provider': provider} (src/sase/notifications/senders.py:375), the modal vocabulary carries it (notification_modal_constants.py:22,45), and _notification_modal_flow.py:207 dispatches to handle_open_launch_control. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
